statement: During wound-induced hair neogenesis in mice, scar-forming myofibroblasts convert into adipocytes, dependent on BMP signalling from the new hair follicles.

context.model: large full-thickness wounds with hair neogenesis

measurement.effect: myofibroblasts adopt adipocyte fate in regenerating wounds

replication.note: One collaboration (Plikus/Cotsarelis). No independent replication cited.
